annotations.text:
Eight directions, no two sharing a silhouette — die-cut means the SHAPE is a design decision, so none of these is a circle.

Three families:

THE GLYPH — the mark itself becomes the sticker.

SEVEN STARS — the festival's own construction borrowed: chunky extruded faces, arched lines, starfields, Art Nouveau scrollwork.

INDUSTRIAL — the trade-union half of the aesthetic, which nothing in the system had used yet. Equipment marking rather than merch.

Plus one vintage decal, which is really a template for dating a sticker to a weekend.
